name: Preview And Copy
summary: Tabbed preview-card shaping, options-driven row grouping, per-module table sorting, forced Loads/Skids combined-row counts in combine modes, data-aware column selection, and clipboard-ready email formatting for generated report output.

uiElements: Forced Loads/Skids column during combine modes
userActions: Choose row display mode in the options dialog
Choose how each module table is sorted in the options dialog
Choose preview modules and columns in the modal options dialog
validationHints: Confirm selected row-display mode shapes both the on-screen detail table and copied output
Confirm each module table can sort independently without changing the other module tables
Confirm sort direction and sort field change both the on-screen table and copied output order
Confirm combine modes force the Loads/Skids column on and prevent it from being disabled in options
Confirm the Loads/Skids value becomes the number of raw rows combined into each displayed row
Confirm preview sections, summary tables, module cards, and included-card lists still rebuild correctly after whole-collection replacement
Confirm selected preview modules and columns control both the on-screen table and copied output
Confirm columns without data are not enabled by default
